landing.headline: Understand your money. Plan your goals. Build better habits.
landing.subhead: Moneyflow keeps your numbers, tracks real spending against your plan, simulates what-if scenarios with real math, and checks in with you every month.

health.title: Financial health score
health.body: A transparent score out of 100 from savings rate, emergency fund, debt load and fixed costs.

plan.title: A plan that adapts
plan.body: Budgets, goal timelines and debt payoff, with a what-if simulator that updates instantly.

coach.title: An AI coach that explains
coach.body: The AI never does the math. It explains results the code computed, and checks in monthly.
